title: Baited documents
description: Generate Office, PDF, RTF, HTML, and other document formats with an embedded tripwire URL. A hit requires the reader to fetch it; external-content settings and reader support matter.

title: A honey directory
description: A ZIP of documents, text files, and shortcuts tied to one key. Plain-text bait only triggers when its URL is followed. Opening the ZIP or reading passwords.txt alone does not send an alert.

title: Host-event installers
description: Create alarms for supported login, sudo, boot, wake, and network events on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Device bundles group relevant installers; SSH snippets can include the remote client's IP.

title: Credential and config bait
description: Generate .env files, AWS credential profiles, cookie jars, bookmarks, and connection profiles. Detection depends on using the embedded endpoint or link, not simply reading a fake secret.

title: Bulk creation and fleet enrollment
description: Create many keys together, use device bundles, and provision keys with stable external IDs. Create-only enrollment credentials support managed-device rollout without handing out an admin key.

title: Copied websites and stylesheets
description: Embed a CSS canary or a JavaScript clone detector. A copied page can fetch the URL when it renders. Configure the expected hostname for the JS detector; referrer information may be missing.

title: Smart-home triggers and actions
description: Home Assistant and Scrypted snippets turn automation events into hits. A Home Assistant destination can invoke your own automation in response; a LAN helper covers supported local device events.

title: NFC tags, QR labels, and Wallet
description: Write a tripwire URL to an NFC tag or print a QR label. A scan or tap must open the URL to trigger. Either backend can supply a tag URL. Generated Apple Wallet passes require full-server signing configuration; supported install, uninstall, and fetch callbacks can record hits.

title: Use your existing alerting
description: Send to webhook, email, Slack, Discord, Teams, or Home Assistant. A per-key status URL lets Uptime Kuma poll for a hit and use its notification integrations.

title: Deduplication and delivery retries
description: Suppress repeated alerts within a configurable window. A Postgres-backed queue retries failed deliveries with backoff and records permanent failures after the attempt limit. Monitor delivery failures as well as hits.
